Name: More Breakfast
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][color=#ffd966][size=5][font=Courier New]UPDATE on 10/30/2026[/font][/size][/color]
[/b][size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#efefef]Shared ingredients and crafting equipment have moved to [/color][color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Ingredients[/color][color=#efefef] and [/color][color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Craftables[/color][color=#efefef].[/color]
[color=#efefef]Please install both mods and their requirements when updating. More Breakfast contains the breakfast dishes and their recipes. You can choose which other More food mods to install—you don’t need the entire series.[/color]
[color=#ff0000]Remove the old More Breakfast folder before installing the updated version to avoid leaving outdated files behind.[/color][/b][/font][/size]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Download and unzip the file.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Keep the folder structure as it is.
[u][color=#ff0000]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/color][/u][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
REMOVE the old folder first.

DO NOT just overwrite when it update.

Version 4.0.0 is completely different from previous versions.

Manifest.Name: More Breakfast
Manifest.Description: Adds 20 breakfast cooking recipes with flexible ingredients and high-resolution icons through Scale Up Unofficial.
